findings.summary: Browser version restore deletes later Hermes profile edits (config.yaml, .env, SOUL.md, plugins/lifeos) without a guard or archive.
findings.expected: Restore refuses or archives when profile mount targets changed after the update.
findings.actual: Guard passes; config.yaml reverts; .env added after update is deleted; no copy retained.
findings.correction: Record post-update digests/modes of mount targets; validate_restore refuses on difference, or archive current targets before replacement; add regression test.

findings.caller_path: Inference.ts -> bin/claude (LIFEOS_CHILD_INFERENCE_DIRECT=1) -> claude_direct.main -> check_call(request={'model'}) -> POST ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
findings.summary: Direct child inference runs memory admission on a model-only body, so forgotten claims in the child system prompt or content reach the model.
findings.expected: Child exits non-zero and the gateway receives no request.
findings.actual: Exit 0; gateway receives 1 request whose system prompt contains the forgotten claim; same check refuses when given the full body.
findings.correction: Pass the actual request_body to check_call and send the checked body; add regression test with forgotten text in system and user content.

findings.summary: Private recorder captures full hook env; names like ANTHROPIC_KEY, GH_PAT, SSH_PASSPHRASE and path-embedded webhook secrets survive redaction.
findings.correction: Do not record env values, or record names plus an allowlist.

findings.summary: Each mount leaves permanent 0600 copies of .env and config.yaml under <profile>/.lifeos-mount/<uuid>/; no cleanup.
findings.correction: Prune snapshots not referenced by the current journal after committed or rolled_back.

hypotheses.summary: No job lock on restore/recover launch; concurrent requests can start two workers and leave the gateway stopped.
3600 s apply grant may expire during a long update, causing post-swap rollback with an unclear cause.
Writes during copy window are lost for non-symlinked LIFEOS/MEMORY layouts; managed layout requires symlinks so governed writes are unaffected.

optional_improvements: Revoke grant when run_update_job initial validation fails (update_worker.py:227-229).
